proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9238.2 *bēṭṭa explicitly gives Bengali beṭā son/beṭi daughter, Maithili beṭā/beṭī, Nepali beṭo/beṭi, Gujarati/Marwari beṭo/beṭī and Western Pahari beṭṭɔ/beṭi. The selected beta/beti pairs fit this specific child branch rather than the defective head. Survey dental t, including explicit dental diacritics, is preserved as a local transcription/phonological qualification; the link does not silently change it to ṭ or resolve regional borrowing. Exact response: beta.
